question: How do directional copy and recovery bandwidth and modeled replacement duration affect both the existing all-workflow WCT denominator and a policy-independent set of workflows targeted by each failure probe?
selection_policy: Retain every registered path, value, policy, domain, probe, and paired seed. The failure-target denominator is frozen before policy execution and may not be redrawn, filtered, or replaced based on result shape.

frozen_common_configuration.capacity_and_copy_recovery_gates: inherit parent v3.1.3 protocol without relaxation

failure_target_denominator.reference_trace: For each seed, construct one protection-disabled nominal trace from the common workflow universe, arrival stream, DAG, source-rank placement, service model, and serving-capacity gate. It contains no policy-specific backup admission, copy, reclaim, failover, or recovery action.
probe_construction_order: Generate the 12 equal-width stratified measurement-window timestamps from the paired seed.
At each timestamp, enumerate reference-trace source ranks having at least one nominally active source task.
Choose one source rank uniformly with the seed-derived probe RNG before any policy or treatment executes.
Freeze the tuple (seed, probe_id, timestamp_ms, source_rank, source_node) and its SHA-256.
Derive the worker/GPU and source-node target workflow-ID sets from the same frozen reference trace and tuple.
failure_target_denominator.source_worker_gpu_target_formula: sorted unique workflow_id where reference source_rank equals probe source_rank and nominal_start_ms <= probe timestamp_ms < nominal_finish_ms
failure_target_denominator.source_node_target_formula: sorted unique workflow_id where floor(reference source_rank / 8) equals floor(probe source_rank / 8) and nominal_start_ms <= probe timestamp_ms < nominal_finish_ms
failure_target_denominator.empty_target_rule: FAIL_CLOSE the seed before policy execution; never resample the timestamp or source rank and never substitute an outcome-bearing workflow
failure_target_denominator.cross_policy_invariant: For each (seed, failure_type, probe_id), the timestamp, source rank, target workflow count, sorted ID set, and identity hash are byte-identical for every policy, direction, bandwidth value, and repair duration where that failure type is evaluated.
failure_target_denominator.fault_domain_invariant: source_worker_gpu invalidates exactly the selected source rank; source_node invalidates exactly the complete 8-rank node containing that selected source rank

replay_metric_per_probe.failure_target_wct_ms: mean over the fixed target IDs of replayed workflow completion_ms minus workflow arrival_ms
replay_metric_per_probe.failure_target_healthy_wct_ms: mean over the same fixed target IDs of healthy workflow completion_ms minus workflow arrival_ms
replay_metric_per_probe.changed_only_wct: reported, if desired, only as within-policy diagnostic and never used as a cross-policy denominator

failure_target_denominator.aggregation: Average the 12 probe-level target-set means with equal probe weight within each cell; pair Native Mooncake and AegisKV by the identical seed/probe target hashes; then report Student-t 95% CI across the three seed-level paired effects (df=2).
failure_target_denominator.probe_weighting_reason: Equal probe weighting prevents the larger source-node target sets from silently receiving more weight than worker/GPU probes.
failure_target_denominator.planned_raw_artifact: failure_target_probe_metrics.csv with one immutable row per cell and probe, including target_id_sha256, target_count, failure type, source rank/node, replay WCT, healthy WCT, added WCT, recovery action, surviving committed tier, and copy/recovery counters

statistics.primary_denominator: unchanged all workflows in the common 90-180 s measurement cohort
report_for_both: absolute Native Mooncake minus AegisKV WCT saved
relative 1 minus AegisKV divided by Native Mooncake WCT gain
Student-t 95% paired CI across three seeds
per-probe target count distribution and effective probe/seed sample sizes
mechanisms: copy service, queue, bytes, jobs, and committed coverage
recovery service, recovery hit, surviving tier, and replacement/activation action
statistics.performance_direction_gates: none; copy is asynchronous and is not required to improve healthy WCT, recovery sensitivity, target WCT, or gain

hard_gates_before_atomic_publication: all workflow-universe, measurement-cohort, probe-base-tuple, and failure-target-ID hashes agree in every registered cross-policy/treatment comparison
each failure-target set is nonempty and was frozen before policy execution
worker/GPU invalidates exactly one rank and source-node invalidates exactly the corresponding eight ranks
cross-node committed replicas survive source-node failure; same-node replicas do not
empty replay reproduces healthy completion within 1e-7 ms and fault replay never lowers workflow WCT within 1e-7 ms
capacity, controller-copy, physical-copy, eviction, and recovery byte accounting conserve
all-workflow primary and failure-target secondary metrics are both emitted; changed-only is never substituted for either denominator
all directions, values, policies, failure domains, probes, and seeds retained regardless of sign or curve shape

implementation_state.execution_gate: BLOCKED until runner, mechanism tests, and their source SHA-256 values are added to a new immutable protocol revision before creating any v2 raw cell

evidence_boundary: This file is a preregistered design only. It creates no new simulation evidence. S7 v1 remains the current 168-cell metadata-DES result. A100 bandwidth, 500 ms activation, and replacement durations remain modeled/unmeasured; Native Mooncake remains a modeled Router+Store approximation.
